title: quekettia peruviana
intro: Quekettia peruviana, commonly known as the orchid tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Quekettia peruviana include its ability to act as an antimicrobial, antiseptic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its various medicinal properties.
